question: Should Twilio RCS ship as a bundled OpenClaw channel, or as an external ClawHub plugin using the current channel and plugin SDK seams?
rationale: The implementation is technically substantial, but repository policy places optional provider-specific channels outside core when existing extension seams are sufficient; only maintainers can choose an exception for a bundled phone-number transport.

options.title: Publish as an external RCS plugin
options.body: Move the Twilio-specific package out of the bundled distribution, retain the existing SDK-based design, and publish it with setup, secret, update, and live smoke documentation.

options.title: Sponsor a bundled core channel
options.body: Explicitly accept the core scope and dependency change, then require an upgrade-safe SMS collision design and exact-head live RCS transport proof before merge.

options.title: Pause the proposal
options.body: Leave the paired issue open for future sponsorship while avoiding further investment in a core-distribution branch.

recommendation.title: Publish as an external RCS plugin
recommendation.body: Move the Twilio-specific package out of the bundled distribution, retain the existing SDK-based design, and publish it with setup, secret, update, and live smoke documentation.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged SMS channel is the closest existing feature boundary and this decision determines whether RCS remains adjacent bundled transport work or becomes an external plugin.
